title: GetAccountResponse
description: Successful response to get a single account.

data.description: The account returned in this response.

AccountResource.description: Provides information about an Up bank account.

id.description: The unique identifier for this account.

displayName.description: The name associated with the account in the Up application.

accountType.description: The bank account type of this account.

ownershipType.description: The ownership structure for this account.

balance.description:
The available balance of the account, taking into account any amounts
that are currently on hold.

createdAt.description: The date-time at which this account was first opened.

related.description: The link to retrieve the related resource(s) in this relationship.

self.description: The canonical link to this resource within the API.

AccountTypeEnum.description:
Specifies the type of bank account. Currently returned values are
`SAVER`, `TRANSACTIONAL` and `HOME_LOAN`.

MoneyObject.description: Provides information about a value of money.

value.description:
The amount of money, formatted as a string in the relevant currency.
For example, for an Australian dollar value of $10.56, this field will
be `"10.56"`. The currency symbol is not included in the string.

valueInBaseUnits.description:
The amount of money in the smallest denomination for the currency, as a
64-bit integer.  For example, for an Australian dollar value of $10.56,
this field will be `1056`.

OwnershipTypeEnum.description:
Specifies the structure under which a bank account is owned. Currently
returned values are `INDIVIDUAL` and `JOINT`.
